svg.title: RoadAnomaly — the CRISP-DM pipeline
svg.desc: Pipeline diagram: 60 photographs and masks go through the frozen group-aware split (42 train, 9 validation, 9 test) into notebooks 4A, 4B and 4C, which train six models on train and validation only and save one folder per model. Notebook 5 opens the test split once and writes test_results.json; notebook 6 explains every model and writes xai_summary.json. The landing page, the product and the demo read their numbers from those files.
